has utilization

  • CURIE: gmeow:hasUtilization
  • IRI: https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/hasUtilization
  • Category: property
  • Defined by: gmeow:slices/places
  • Box roles: RBox role (What is this?)

Links a location to a utilization measurement describing the ratio of occupancy to capacity. Flat form for the common case; promote to full reified Utilization when vantage, confidence, temporal scope, or standpoint matter.

Structure

Property shape: object property; gmeow:Location -> gmeow:Utilization

Practical Pattern

Use gmeow:hasUtilization from gmeow:Location to gmeow:Utilization when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

Common Companion Terms

gmeow:Location, gmeow:Utilization

Usage Advice

Use when

  • Use as the flat inverse link from a location to a utilization measurement.

Avoid when

  • Avoid it when vantage, confidence, or standpoint matter — read the reified Utilization.

How to use

  • Use gmeow:hasUtilization for the common case; the ratio is solver-derived from capacity and occupancy.

Examples

  • ex:hall gmeow:hasUtilization ex:util.
